binaryStagingBlocker.detail: Firefly generation, asset persistence and actual-pixel inspection succeeded. This Workstream-01 tool context can resolve and inspect authenticated Adobe renditions but cannot expose the binary/base64 payload to GitHub create_blob, and the container has no outbound DNS path to the Adobe short URL. The images therefore remain GENERATED_ADOBE, not STAGED or READY_FOR_REVIEW.
binaryStagingBlocker.requiredResolution: Use the already-proven Adobe GenAI asset-to-Git blob byte bridge from a tool context that can expose the rendition bytes, attach each exact image to its intended versioned path on the newest screenshot-match-preproduction head with force=false, then fetch/read back the Git blob before reviewer 02 inspection.
binaryStagingBlocker.security: No presigned/temporary Adobe URLs are committed; only stable GenAI asset URNs are recorded.

handoff.15: First-cycle binary staging blocker is recorded with stable Adobe GenAI URNs for seating-2/3. If the same blocker persists into the next Workstream-01 cycle, use the existing proven Adobe-to-Git byte bridge rather than regenerating these images.
